segments.text: In the lab, many of the chemicals that we come into contact with are potentially hazardous.
segments.zh: 在实验室里，我们接触到的许多化学品都具有潜在危险性。

segments.text: Formaldehyde, a common laboratory substance, is no exception, but it is special.
segments.zh: 甲醛是一种常见的实验室物质，它也不例外，但它很特殊。

segments.text: Health problems from mishandling formaldehyde can be extremely serious.
segments.zh: 甲醛处理不当所导致的健康问题可能极其严重。

segments.text: So serious that the Occupational Safety and Health Administration, OSHA, has created a
segments.zh: 严重到美国职业安全与健康管理局，也就是 OSHA，专门制定了一项

segments.text: standard for working safely with materials that contain formaldehyde.
segments.zh: 关于安全使用含甲醛物质的标准。

segments.text: The standard includes a list of health problems associated with overexposure to formaldehyde.
segments.zh: 该标准列出了一系列与甲醛过量接触相关的健康问题。

segments.text: They range from the short-term discomfort of minor burns or of skin irritation to chronic
segments.zh: 从轻微灼伤或皮肤刺激带来的短期不适，到长期过量接触

segments.text: effects from prolonged periods of overexposure.
segments.zh: 造成的慢性影响，不一而足。

segments.text: Symptoms are easy to recognize.
segments.zh: 这些症状很容易识别。

segments.text: External contact may cause short-term irritation to the skin, eyes, and mucous membranes.
segments.zh: 外部接触可能会对皮肤、眼睛和黏膜造成短期刺激。

segments.text: Inhaling formaldehyde gas or vapors can induce coughing, nausea, violent vomiting, diarrhea,
segments.zh: 吸入甲醛气体或蒸气可能引起咳嗽、恶心、剧烈呕吐、腹泻

segments.text: and laryngitis.
segments.zh: 和喉炎。

segments.text: Breathing in extremely high concentrations of formaldehyde can bring on convulsions, a coma,
segments.zh: 吸入极高浓度的甲醛可能导致抽搐、昏迷，

segments.text: or even death.
segments.zh: 甚至死亡。

segments.text: The effects of long-term exposure to high levels of formaldehyde may not appear right
segments.zh: 长期接触高浓度甲醛的影响可能不会马上

segments.text: away, but in times, serious problems can develop.
segments.zh: 显现，但随着时间推移，可能会出现严重的问题。

segments.text: Since formaldehyde is a suspected carcinogen and mutagen, overexposure increases the risk
segments.zh: 由于甲醛是一种可疑致癌物和致突变物，过量接触会增加

segments.text: of developing cancer.
segments.zh: 患癌的风险。

segments.text: Formaldehyde is also a chronic toxin.
segments.zh: 甲醛还是一种慢性毒物。

segments.text: As a result, repeated or prolonged exposure can result in permanent respiratory damage.
segments.zh: 因此，反复或长期接触可能导致永久性的呼吸系统损伤。

segments.text: Most of these situations can be helped with medical treatment, so if you think you're
segments.zh: 这些情况大多可以通过医疗来改善，所以如果你认为自己

segments.text: developing symptoms of overexposure, report them to your supervisor immediately.
segments.zh: 出现了过量接触的症状，要立即报告你的主管。

segments.text: Now that we've looked at the health hazards that are associated with formaldehyde, let's
segments.zh: 既然我们已经了解了与甲醛相关的健康危害，那我们

segments.text: take a look at how we can protect ourselves when we're working with it.
segments.zh: 来看看在使用甲醛时如何保护自己。

segments.text: First, if you're working with high concentrations of formaldehyde or work with it frequently,
segments.zh: 首先，如果你使用的是高浓度甲醛，或者经常使用甲醛，

segments.text: you may need to monitor the amount of formaldehyde that you're exposed to.
segments.zh: 你可能需要监测你所接触的甲醛量。

segments.text: This is done through testing the air in your immediate work area by taking individual samples.
segments.zh: 这是通过采集个人样本、检测你周边工作区域的空气来完成的。

segments.text: The test results are then compared to OSHA's permissible exposure limit for formaldehyde,
segments.zh: 然后将检测结果与 OSHA 规定的甲醛容许接触限值进行比较，

segments.text: which is expressed in parts per million.
segments.zh: 该限值以百万分率表示。

segments.text: The current permissible exposure limit is 0.75 parts per million.
segments.zh: 目前的容许接触限值是 0.75 ppm。

segments.text: This limit is calculated for an 8-hour, time-weighted average of exposure.
segments.zh: 这一限值是按 8 小时时间加权平均接触量计算的。

segments.text: If the average level of formaldehyde in the air reaches or exceeds the PEL, you'll need
segments.zh: 如果空气中甲醛的平均浓度达到或超过 PEL，你就需要

segments.text: to take special precautions until the levels are reduced.
segments.zh: 采取特别的预防措施，直到浓度降下来。

segments.text: For some tasks, looking at an 8-hour average of exposure may mask the presence of temporarily
segments.zh: 对于某些任务，只看 8 小时平均接触量，可能会掩盖暂时

segments.text: high levels of formaldehyde.
segments.zh: 出现的高浓度甲醛。

segments.text: So to prevent overexposure in these situations, OSHA has established short-term exposure limits,
segments.zh: 所以为了防止这些情况下的过量接触，OSHA 制定了短时间接触限值，

segments.text: or STELs.
segments.zh: 也就是 STEL。

segments.text: These limits are based on an exposure period of 15 minutes.
segments.zh: 这些限值以 15 分钟的接触时间为基础。

segments.text: OSHA's short-term exposure limit for formaldehyde exposure is no more than 2 parts per million.
segments.zh: OSHA 规定的甲醛短时间接触限值不超过 2 ppm。

segments.text: This may seem like a lot of numbers, but exposure limits have been set up for your
segments.zh: 这些数字看起来可能很多，但接触限值是为了

segments.text: protection.
segments.zh: 保护你而制定的。

segments.text: So make sure that you pay attention to them.
segments.zh: 所以一定要注意它们。

segments.text: If you have any questions, see your supervisor.
segments.zh: 如果你有任何疑问，请找你的主管。

segments.text: The formaldehyde standard also contains a set of training requirements so that everyone who
segments.zh: 甲醛标准还包含一套培训要求，以便每个

segments.text: is using the substance knows how to work with it safely.
segments.zh: 使用这种物质的人都知道如何安全地使用它。

segments.text: Because the adverse health effects of formaldehyde can be so serious, OSHA requires annual training
segments.zh: 由于甲醛对健康的不良影响可能非常严重，OSHA 要求对所有

segments.text: for all employees who are exposed to levels of one-tenth part per million or higher.
segments.zh: 接触浓度达到 0.1 ppm 或更高的员工进行年度培训。

segments.text: For starters, you need to know where formaldehyde is used in your workplace and how you can limit
segments.zh: 首先，你需要知道你的工作场所在哪里使用甲醛，以及如何限制

segments.text: hazardous exposure.
segments.zh: 有害接触。

segments.text: Container labeling plays a major role in providing this type of information.
segments.zh: 容器标签在提供这类信息方面起着重要作用。

segments.text: Labels on mixtures and solutions containing more than one-tenth percent formaldehyde
segments.zh: 含甲醛超过 0.1% 的混合物和溶液，其标签

segments.text: must state specifically that formaldehyde is present and that physical and health hazard
segments.zh: 必须明确注明含有甲醛，并说明可以从雇主处以及物质安全数据表，

segments.text: information is available from your employer and the Mixture Safety Data Sheet, the SDS.
segments.zh: 也就是 SDS，获取物理和健康危害信息。

segments.text: This labeling is also required for any material capable of releasing formaldehyde into the
segments.zh: 对于任何能够向空气中释放浓度达到 0.1 ppm 或更高甲醛的物质，

segments.text: air at concentrations of one-tenth parts per million or higher.
segments.zh: 也要求贴这种标签。

segments.text: Mixtures and solutions containing more than one-fifth percent formaldehyde and materials
segments.zh: 含甲醛超过 0.2% 的混合物和溶液，以及

segments.text: capable of releasing five-tenth parts per million of formaldehyde must be labeled with
segments.zh: 能够释放 0.5 ppm 甲醛的物质，必须贴上

segments.text: the following warnings.
segments.zh: 以下警示：

segments.text: Sensitization of the skin and respiratory system, eye and throat irritation, and acute
segments.zh: 皮肤和呼吸系统致敏、眼睛和喉咙刺激，以及急性

segments.text: toxicity.
segments.zh: 毒性。

segments.text: These labels must also specifically state that formaldehyde is a potential cancer hazard.
segments.zh: 这些标签还必须明确注明甲醛具有潜在的致癌危害。

segments.text: If this information cannot all fit on the container label itself, the label will direct
segments.zh: 如果这些信息无法全部放在容器标签上，标签会指引

segments.text: you to other sources of information such as the SDS.
segments.zh: 你查阅其他信息来源，比如安全技术说明书。

segments.text: The SDS will also tell you how to avoid overexposure while you're working with formaldehyde.
segments.zh: 安全技术说明书还会告诉你在使用甲醛时如何避免过量接触。

segments.text: In the past, many facilities that used formaldehyde had to purchase it at one-hundred
segments.zh: 过去，许多使用甲醛的设施必须购买百分之百

segments.text: percent, then dilute it to the strength they needed.
segments.zh: 浓度的甲醛，然后再稀释到所需的浓度。

segments.text: If you were involved in this type of blending process, you should be especially careful.
segments.zh: 如果你参与过这类配制过程，就应该格外小心。

segments.text: Nowadays, most formaldehyde comes already diluted in dispenser containers or unit packages,
segments.zh: 如今，大多数甲醛在出售时已经稀释好，装在分装容器或单元包装中，

segments.text: but you still need to pay attention to how to handle it.
segments.zh: 但你仍然需要注意如何处理它。

segments.text: Even in a diluted form, formaldehyde can be hazardous.
segments.zh: 即使是稀释过的甲醛，也可能有危险。

segments.text: There's a reason that OSHA's hazard warning requirements begin at solutions containing
segments.zh: OSHA 的危害警示要求从含量仅为 0.1% 的溶液就开始适用，

segments.text: only one-tenth of one percent.
segments.zh: 这是有原因的。

segments.text: The most basic way of shielding yourself from hazardous levels of exposure to formaldehyde
segments.zh: 保护自己免受有害浓度甲醛接触的最基本方法，

segments.text: is through personal protective equipment.
segments.zh: 是使用个人防护装备。

segments.text: Gloves are a good place to start.
segments.zh: 手套是个很好的起点。

segments.text: Protective gloves are often designed to be used with specific substances or hazards.
segments.zh: 防护手套通常是针对特定物质或危害而设计的。

segments.text: When you're working with formaldehyde, OSHA requires you to choose gloves that are
segments.zh: 使用甲醛时，OSHA 要求你选择

segments.text: impervious to solutions of one percent or more.
segments.zh: 能够抵御浓度 1% 或以上溶液渗透的手套。

segments.text: Things containing more than one percent formaldehyde also require you to wear splash-resistant
segments.zh: 含甲醛超过 1% 的物品，还要求你佩戴防溅

segments.text: goggles that provide complete protection for the eyes.
segments.zh: 护目镜，为眼睛提供全面保护。

segments.text: With some jobs, a face shield may also be required to protect your skin, but don't
segments.zh: 在某些工作中，可能还需要戴面罩来保护皮肤，但不要

segments.text: consider face shields as a substitute for goggles.
segments.zh: 把面罩当作护目镜的替代品。

segments.text: Even with a face shield, goggles are required if there's any danger of formaldehyde reaching
segments.zh: 即使戴了面罩，只要有任何甲醛进入眼部区域的危险，

segments.text: the eye area.
segments.zh: 就必须戴护目镜。

segments.text: Where formaldehyde gas is present, you may need to use an air-purifying respirator to
segments.zh: 在存在甲醛气体的地方，你可能需要使用空气净化式呼吸器来

segments.text: protect your nasal passages, throat, and lungs.
segments.zh: 保护你的鼻腔、喉咙和肺部。

segments.text: You must undergo training and a fit test whenever you're issued a new respirator and at least
segments.zh: 每次领用新的呼吸器时，你都必须接受培训和适合性测试，此后至少

segments.text: once a year thereafter.
segments.zh: 每年一次。

segments.text: When you receive your respirator, you'll also be given the appropriate filter cartridge
segments.zh: 领取呼吸器时，你还会得到与你工作区域甲醛浓度

segments.text: for the level of formaldehyde in your work area.
segments.zh: 相适应的滤盒。

segments.text: See your supervisor for information about your facility's respiratory protection program.
segments.zh: 关于你们设施的呼吸防护计划，请向主管了解。

segments.text: This will discuss the proper selection, training, and fit testing of respirators, as well as
segments.zh: 它会讲到呼吸器的正确选择、培训和适合性测试，以及

segments.text: how often the cartridges will need to be replaced.
segments.zh: 滤盒需要多久更换一次。

segments.text: In addition to gloves, eyewear, and possibly a respirator, you're also going to need
segments.zh: 除了手套、护目镜，可能还有呼吸器之外，你还需要

segments.text: some type of protective clothing to shield you from splashes when working with formaldehyde.
segments.zh: 某种防护服，在使用甲醛时防止溅洒。

segments.text: Lab coats are the most common, but they and any other clothing you wear must be impervious
segments.zh: 实验服是最常见的，但实验服和你穿的任何其他衣物都必须能防水，

segments.text: to water to fully protect you.
segments.zh: 才能为你提供全面保护。

segments.text: If your protective clothing ever becomes contaminated, you should immediately dispose of it in your
segments.zh: 如果你的防护服被污染了，应立即把它丢弃到你们

segments.text: facility's authorized disposal area.
segments.zh: 设施指定的处置区域。

segments.text: Then get a replacement before you start back to work.
segments.zh: 然后换上新的再开始工作。

segments.text: Another important part of working safely with formaldehyde is following proper work practices.
segments.zh: 安全使用甲醛的另一个重要方面是遵守正确的作业规范。

segments.text: The safety data sheet is key.
segments.zh: 安全技术说明书是关键。

segments.text: Be sure to follow all of the recommended handling and storage procedures for the formaldehyde
segments.zh: 一定要遵守你所使用的含甲醛物质的

segments.text: material that you're using.
segments.zh: 所有推荐搬运和储存程序。

segments.text: It's also extremely important that you follow all of your lab's recommended procedures.
segments.zh: 遵守你们实验室的所有推荐程序也极其重要。

segments.text: They may require special protective measures, depending on the work you're doing.
segments.zh: 根据你所做的工作，它们可能要求采取特殊的防护措施。

segments.text: Remember, these practices and procedures have been set up for your benefit.
segments.zh: 记住，这些规范和程序是为了你的利益而制定的。

segments.text: Maintaining proper ventilation in your work area is one of the most important safe work
segments.zh: 保持工作区域的良好通风，是所有安全作业规范中

segments.text: practices of all.
segments.zh: 最重要的之一。

segments.text: Be sure to use lab hoods and other ventilation devices to keep any formaldehyde that's
segments.zh: 一定要使用实验室通风柜和其他通风装置，让空气中的

segments.text: in the air out of your breathing zone.
segments.zh: 任何甲醛远离你的呼吸区。

segments.text: Not all hoods and air evacuation devices operate the same way, so make sure you know how yours
segments.zh: 并非所有通风柜和排风装置的工作方式都一样，所以一定要了解你所用的

segments.text: works.
segments.zh: 是怎样工作的。

segments.text: And be sure to follow all the rules for the safe use of these devices.
segments.zh: 并且一定要遵守安全使用这些装置的所有规定。

segments.text: Even if you've taken all the recommended precautions, you still need to know what to do in case
segments.zh: 即使你已经采取了所有推荐的预防措施，你仍然需要知道

segments.text: an accident with formaldehyde occurs.
segments.zh: 万一发生甲醛事故时该怎么做。

segments.text: No matter how careful we are, things can go wrong.
segments.zh: 无论我们多么小心，事情都可能出错。

segments.text: You need to be prepared so that you can minimize the effects of any mishaps.
segments.zh: 你需要做好准备，以便将任何意外的影响降到最低。

segments.text: To help you with this, your facility has developed a specific plan for dealing with accidents
segments.zh: 为了帮助你做到这一点，你们设施制定了专门的计划来处理

segments.text: in your work area, but there are some things that should be done any time an incident
segments.zh: 工作区域内的事故，但每当发生涉及甲醛的事件时，

segments.text: involving formaldehyde occurs.
segments.zh: 都有一些事情应该去做。

segments.text: In the event of a small spill, soak up the liquid with an absorbent material like vermiculite
segments.zh: 如果发生少量溅洒，用蛭石或吸附枕之类的吸附材料

segments.text: or a spill pillow.
segments.zh: 把液体吸干。

segments.text: Place the waste into a properly labeled and sealed container for later disposal.
segments.zh: 把废物放入正确标识并密封的容器中，以便日后处置。

segments.text: Do not attempt to handle large spills of formaldehyde.
segments.zh: 不要试图处理大量的甲醛溅洒。

segments.text: Formaldehyde is toxic, and the fumes from even a dilute solution can overwhelm you.
segments.zh: 甲醛有毒，即使是稀溶液的烟气也可能让你招架不住。

segments.text: Alert other personnel in the area and vacate the laboratory immediately.
segments.zh: 提醒该区域的其他人员，并立即撤离实验室。

segments.text: Then call for assistance.
segments.zh: 然后呼叫援助。

segments.text: If you come into contact with formaldehyde, it's important to act quickly.
segments.zh: 如果你接触到了甲醛，迅速行动很重要。

segments.text: For skin contact, immediately remove any contaminated clothing.
segments.zh: 如果是皮肤接触，立即脱去任何被污染的衣物。

segments.text: Wash the affected area with soap or mild detergent and large quantities of water for at least
segments.zh: 用肥皂或温和的洗涤剂和大量清水清洗受影响的部位，至少

segments.text: 15 to 20 minutes.
If the area of contact is large, get to a safety shower.
segments.zh: 如果接触面积大，就去紧急喷淋处。

segments.text: Remove all your clothing and stay under the water for at least 15 minutes.
segments.zh: 脱掉全部衣物，在水下冲淋至少 15 分钟。

segments.text: Be sure to get medical attention after any contact.
segments.zh: 任何接触之后都一定要就医。

segments.text: If formaldehyde splashes into your eyes, water is again the first line of defense.
segments.zh: 如果甲醛溅入眼睛，水同样是第一道防线。

segments.text: Immediately go to your lab's eyewash station and wash the formaldehyde out of your eyes.
segments.zh: 立即到实验室的洗眼器处，把眼睛里的甲醛冲洗出来。

segments.text: Stay in the water for a minimum of 15 minutes.
segments.zh: 冲洗至少 15 分钟。

segments.text: Hold your eyes open with your fingers to make sure the water covers the entire area.
segments.zh: 用手指撑开眼睛，确保水覆盖整个区域。

segments.text: Then get medical attention as quickly as possible.
segments.zh: 然后尽快就医。

segments.text: If someone accidentally swallows formaldehyde, immediately provide them with drinking water.
segments.zh: 如果有人误食了甲醛，立即给他们喝饮用水。

segments.text: Keep the person warm and calm and get medical attention.
segments.zh: 让患者保持温暖和平静，并就医。

segments.text: In the event that someone inhales formaldehyde fumes, remove them from the exposure area and
segments.zh: 如果有人吸入了甲醛烟气，把他们带离暴露区域，

segments.text: get them to fresh air.
segments.zh: 转移到空气新鲜的地方。

segments.text: Then call for an ambulance.
segments.zh: 然后呼叫救护车。

segments.text: Keep the victim warm and calm until medical help arrives.
segments.zh: 在医疗救助到来之前，让伤者保持温暖和平静。

segments.text: You need to be careful when responding to any of these accident situations.
segments.zh: 应对任何这类事故情况时，你都需要小心。

segments.text: Never enter an area that has a high concentration of formaldehyde.
segments.zh: 绝不要进入甲醛浓度很高的区域，

segments.text: Look for rescuers who have appropriate respiratory protection.
segments.zh: 要找配有适当呼吸防护的救援人员。

segments.text: Another way that the formaldehyde standard helps to ensure employee health and safety
segments.zh: 甲醛标准帮助保障员工健康与安全的另一种方式，

segments.text: is through its medical surveillance plan.
segments.zh: 是它的医学监护计划。

segments.text: Under the plan, anyone who is adversely affected by exposure to formaldehyde must be given
segments.zh: 根据该计划，任何因接触甲醛而受到不良影响的人，都必须被安排

segments.text: a temporary work assignment with reduced exposure to the chemical.
segments.zh: 一个减少接触该化学品的临时工作岗位。

segments.text: After a reasonable amount of time has passed, the facility will then determine whether the
segments.zh: 经过一段合理的时间后，设施将确定

segments.text: affected employee should return to their old position, remaining the temporary job, or if
segments.zh: 受影响的员工是应该回到原来的岗位、继续留在临时岗位，还是

segments.text: other options need to be considered.
segments.zh: 需要考虑其他选择。

segments.text: If you have any questions about your facility's medical surveillance plan, see your supervisor.
segments.zh: 如果你对你们设施的医学监护计划有任何疑问，请找你的主管。

segments.text: While formaldehyde can be hazardous, we do know how to work with it safely.
segments.zh: 虽然甲醛可能有危险，但我们确实知道如何安全地使用它。

segments.text: Let's review.
segments.zh: 我们来回顾一下。

segments.text: Know the hazards that formaldehyde presents.
segments.zh: 了解甲醛带来的危害。

segments.text: Be aware of the materials in your work area that contain formaldehyde.
segments.zh: 知道你的工作区域中有哪些物质含有甲醛。

segments.text: Know what you should do to protect yourself when you work with formaldehyde.
segments.zh: 知道使用甲醛时应该怎样保护自己。

segments.text: And be prepared to act in case of a spill or other formaldehyde accident.
segments.zh: 并做好准备，以便在发生溅洒或其他甲醛事故时采取行动。

segments.text: Knowing the hazards that formaldehyde presents and complying with OSHA's formaldehyde standard
segments.zh: 了解甲醛带来的危害，并在使用时遵守 OSHA 的甲醛标准，

segments.text: when you use it will make working with formaldehyde easier and safer for everyone.
segments.zh: 会让每个人使用甲醛时都更轻松、更安全。
